title: (RHBA-2018:3762) Fuse 7.2.0 images
portal_summary: Red Hat Fuse 7.2.0 release of 'Fuse on OpenShift' and 'Fuse Online (Ignite)' images.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|3.11|x86_64
Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|3.10|x86_64
portal_solution:
This release consists of the following parts:
* Fuse on OpenShift images (provided through the Red Hat container catalog)
* Fuse Online (Ignite) images (provided through the Red Hat container catalog)
* Maven dependencies (provided through the Red Hat Maven repository)

These images are intended for use with the following components:
* Red Hat Fuse version: 7.2.0.fuse-720020-redhat-00001
* Maven archetype version: 2.2.0.fuse-720018-redhat-00001

To update your Maven POM file for the old-style BOM:
* Fabric8 BOM version: 3.0.11.fuse-720027-redhat-00001
* Fabric8 Maven plug-in version: 3.5.33.fuse-720026-redhat-00001
* Wildfly Camel BOM version: 5.2.0.fuse-720023-redhat-00001

To update your Maven POM file for the new-style BOM:
* redhat-fuse BOM Version: 7.2.0.fuse-720020-redhat-00001

The base URL for the Fuse on OpenShift image streams and templates in this release is:
https://github.com/jboss-fuse/application-templates/tree/application-templates-2.1.fuse-720018-redhat-00001

In this release, the Fuse on OpenShift images are distributed through the registry.redhat.io image registry for the first time. This is a secure registry that requires you to create authentication credentials in your OpenShift cluster before you can install the images.
For more details, see https://access.redhat.com/documentation/en-us/red_hat_fuse/7.2/html-single/fuse_on_openshift_guide/#configure-container-registry.

To install the Fuse on OpenShift image streams, log in to OpenShift as an administrator and enter the following command:

oc create -n openshift -f \
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jboss-fuse/application-templates/application-templates-2.1.fuse-720018-redhat-00001/fis-image-streams.json

And to install the Fuse on OpenShift templates, enter the following command:

for template in eap-camel-amq-template.json \
 eap-camel-cdi-template.json \
 eap-camel-cxf-jaxrs-template.json \
 eap-camel-cxf-jaxws-template.json \
 eap-camel-jpa-template.json \
 karaf-camel-amq-template.json \
 karaf-camel-log-template.json \
 karaf-camel-rest-sql-template.json \
 karaf-cxf-rest-template.json \
 spring-boot-camel-amq-template.json \
 spring-boot-camel-config-template.json \
 spring-boot-camel-drools-template.json \
 spring-boot-camel-infinispan-template.json \
 spring-boot-camel-rest-sql-template.json \
 spring-boot-camel-teiid-template.json \
 spring-boot-camel-template.json \
 spring-boot-camel-xa-template.json \
 spring-boot-camel-xml-template.json \
 spring-boot-cxf-jaxrs-template.json \
 spring-boot-cxf-jaxws-template.json ;
 do
 oc create -n openshift -f \
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jboss-fuse/application-templates/application-templates-2.1.fuse-720018-redhat-00001/quickstarts/${template}
 done

To install the templates for Fuse Console (Hawtio), enter the following commands:

oc create -n openshift -f https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jboss-fuse/application-templates/application-templates-2.1.fuse-720018-redhat-00001/fis-console-cluster-template.json
oc create -n openshift -f https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jboss-fuse/application-templates/application-templates-2.1.fuse-720018-redhat-00001/fis-console-namespace-template.json

To install the template for Apicurito, enter the following command:

oc create -n openshift -f https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jboss-fuse/application-templates/application-templates-2.1.fuse-720018-redhat-00001/fuse-apicurito.yml
portal_description:
This advisory makes available the images for Fuse on OpenShift (previously
called Fuse Integration Services) and Fuse Online (Ignite) for Red Hat Fuse 7.2.0.
